messages:
Anna (Marketing): Hey folks — moving fast on the upcoming release. Need final changelog entry + docs links by EOD today. Also need canary start time for rollout and a short benchmark blurb for the announcement. Can the eng owners confirm?
Sam (Eng): On it. Which release tag? v2.3.0?
Anna (Marketing): Yep v2.3.0. Key points: embeddings cost optimizations, new prefix cache, improved throughput for long-context models. We want a one-paragraph benchmark line and a figure (latency vs tokens) if possible.
Leo (Docs): I'll draft docs links. Current PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 — will merge once changelog is locked.
Sam (Eng): Changelog draft:
```
- v2.3.0 — Reduced per-token latency by 18% on MPT-30b with prefix KV caching, added embedding quantization profile, stability fixes for streaming.
```
Sam (Eng): Can marketing edit wording. We're planning canary at 2026-03-27 10:00 PT for 2 hours, then gradually increase. Jay can confirm infra.
Jay (SRE): Canary window OK. We'll route 5% traffic to dedicated pool for the first hour, 20% next hour. I'll post deploy links in release channel.
Mina (Growth): Webinar timing: can we target March 31 (afternoon PT)? Need final talking points by Tuesday. Also want a short benchmark slide and a screenshot from the console.
Anna (Marketing): Perfect. Mina, I'll send speaker list. Leo can you add a "What changed" snippet for the top of the docs page.
Leo (Docs): Adding `what's new` snippet to PR. Short blurb completed.
Sam (Eng): One more: we need fallback plan if latency spike — fallback to v2.2.4 model variant. Adding to rollout policy.
Anna (Marketing): Great. For inbound lead routing: Mina to own tagging via /webhook with utm=release_v2_3. Who owns the webhooks?
Jay (SRE): Integrations team will add the tag. Ping @integrations-bot when deploy finishes.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary start 1767129600 (2026-03-27 10:00 PT). Status: scheduled.
Anna (Marketing): Final asks: (1) Changelog locked in PR by 18:00 PT today (2) Docs links merged and final URL shared in this thread (3) Canary timing confirmed (4) Benchmark blurb (1-2 sentences) + one PNG screenshot of console metrics.
Sam (Eng): We'll hit that. I'll post final changelog in here before 17:30 PT.
Leo (Docs): Will post final docs URL when merged: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/v2.3
Mina (Growth): I'll queue the webinar invite and share a draft announcement for review tonight.
Anna (Marketing): Thanks everyone :tada:
Sam (Eng): posted changelog: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/commit/abcd1234
Leo (Docs): merged docs PR, live at https://docs.redwood.ai/release/v2.3
Jay (SRE): Canary started as scheduled, monitoring. ping me if anomalies.
Anna (Marketing): Received. Will draft release post and share for signoff by 09:00 PT tomorrow.
